newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in moderate trade on Monday, dealers said.
Most traders were waiting for fresh clues to market direction from Tuesday's release of the U.S. second quarter employment cost index (ECI) and July consumer confidence index data, they said.
The employment cost index for the second quarter is forecast to show an increase of 0.8 percent compared with a 0.6 percent gain reported in the first quarter.
The consumer index for July is expected to show a reading of 130.4 against June's 129.6.

"Rates were steady to higher in the morning on some position adjustments. Some traders are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from Tuesday's employment cost index and consumer confidence index figures," a local dealer said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday and Tuesday/Wednesday rose 1/16 percentage point each to a common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent. Week-fixed rose 1/16 point to 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month rose 1/16 point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-7/8 5-3/4 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 percent. -P. Theseira (65-8703085)
